shipLog.text: ◆ Station approach. Life support here is maintained by the lowest bidder. MARV has met the lowest bidder. He would like to be undocked by evening.
◆ Crop planted. MARV has opened a file for it. He opens a file for everything that might end. It is a large cabinet.
Arrived: Asteroid Field 1. The leg cost −3 FUEL, +2 MORALE, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
Departure Protocol. The captain chose “Check the crop one last time before departure”. Noted.
The crop is fine. +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
◆ Entering the asteroid field. MARV has calculated the collision odds and finds them survivable, which he notes is his most cheerful category.
Arrived: HD 40307g. The leg cost −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, +2 MORALE, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
The Half-Built Relay. The captain chose “Give them the time”. Noted.
Your ship holds the girder steady while their welders walk the seam. +5 FUEL, +4 MORALE, 4 DAYS. It will not last.
◆ A planet. MARV observes that it has been doing perfectly well without us. He does not expect that to continue.
Arrived: Nebula 3. The leg cost −3 FUEL, +2 MORALE, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
Vessel Approaching. The captain chose “Fight — bring weapons online”. Noted.
Vessel Approaching. Won. −41 HULL, +1 FUEL CELL, +2 MORALE, +6 GOLD, 2 DAYS. The universe will invoice us later.
◆ We departed Earth orbit with every item technically fine. I have been watching ‘technically’ erode ever since.
◆ REPAIR — all four systems nominal, hull patched (+20).
Arrived: Supply Point 7 (There Is No Supply…. The leg cost −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, +2 MORALE, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
